description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not specify this parameter for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

description.zh: 场景联动规则ID。调用[QuerySceneRule](~~169498~~)接口获取场景联动规则ID。
description.en: The ID of the scene orchestration rule. You can call the [QuerySceneRule](~~169498~~) API to obtain the rule ID.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为50。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Conditions
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 50 queries per second (QPS) to call this API.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot enable-scene-rule --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --rule-id f041397879ad4d89822811d741000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
